crossRefs.note: Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass? Or does the ox low over his fodder?
An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.
He will be like a wild donkey among men. His hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him. He will…

translations.web: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles .
translations.bsb: They cried out among the shrubs and huddled beneath the nettles.
translations.kjv: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.
translations.asv: Among the bushes they bray; Under the nettles they are gathered together.
